name: DoinGud marketplace acceptOffer zero-amount replay
summary: The DoinGud marketplace facet's acceptOffer(offerer, tokenId, price, amount) pays the full offer price from the diamond's USDC escrow even with amount 0, transfers no NFT, keeps the offer and lets the offerer accept its own offer. The attacker funded a self-offer with flash-swapped USDC and accepted it twice, draining other users' escrow.
notes: DiamondCut on the DoinGud diamond Replaced selectors 0x5c924960 (acceptOffer), 0x2fdced43, 0x7e30474a, 0xf6dbe82d (makeOffer) and 0x696bd1d3 with marketplace facet 0x123aafc8d0a07ce1a146e53aa899e77f21a2dde1 (data word 11) and Added 0x49c5fc38 to it. It is the last of 18 DiamondCut events that routes acceptOffer or makeOffer; facetAddress(0x5c924960) and facetAddress(0xf6dbe82d) still return the facet at block 94170780.

Gross depletion of the diamond's pre-existing USDC.e escrow (third-party deposits accumulated from 2021 to 2023): the balance falls from 35486.935717 at block 94170780 to 0 after the exploit. The attacker's own flash-swapped deposit of the same amount (log 3) is returned by the first accept (log 6) and is not loss. The attacker's net 35380.154566 USDC.e is lower by the 106.781151 USDC.e flash-swap fee paid to the pair, which does not reduce victim depletion.
